say: This video shows how to allow a pharmacy to issue items to its own department. By default, this is not allowed. Let's see that first.
Open the Pharmacy menu, and click Consumption.
Choose your own department, Main Pharmacy, as the department to issue to. Then click Select.
The system blocks it. The message says your department does not allow issues to the same department.
To change this, open the Administration menu, and click Manage Institutions.
Settings on this page apply only to the department you are logged in to. Change Allow Disposal Issue to Same Department, to Allowed.
Click Save. The change takes effect immediately.
Now go back. Open the Pharmacy menu, click Consumption, and then New Consumption Issue.
Choose Main Pharmacy again, and click Select.
This time the issue screen opens, and you can issue items to your own department. Only administrators can change this setting.
